name: World of Warcraft: Forever
summary: World of Warcraft: Forever takes place in the year after the Third War. Thrall's Horde has settled Durotar, and a regent rules Stormwind for its boy-king. The Forsaken hold the Undercity. The world reaches from the Skyborne of Zephras Isle to the contested Riverglades and Shen'dralas, sacred Mount Hyjal and the city of Dalaran rising from its ruins in the Alterac Mountains.

sections.title: The World After the Third War
sections.body:
The Burning Legion has been driven back at Mount Hyjal, yet the world bears the hurt it left behind. Thrall's Horde of orcs, trolls and tauren has made its home in Durotar and Mulgore. The Forsaken under Sylvanas Windrunner have joined the Horde from the ruins of Lordaeron.

In Stormwind, Highlord Bolvar Fordragon rules as regent for the boy-king Anduin Wrynn while King Varian is missing. The dwarves of Ironforge, the exiled gnomes and the night elves of Teldrassil stand with the Alliance. The Scourge still holds the Plaguelands.

sections.title: The Skyborne
sections.body:
The Skyborne, or shen'dorei, descend from night elves who rebelled against Prince Tortheldrin of Eldre'Thalas. Wind spirits carried their island, Zephras Isle, into Skywall, the Elemental Plane of Air, and the Skyborne escaped with it. Ages there made them high elves, and more are now born blue-skinned.

The spirits vanished centuries ago, and Zephras Isle is slowly breaking apart. The Skyborne look back toward Azeroth. Their airships reach the Alterac Mountains near Dalaran and Mulgore's Skywatcher Plateau. They fight for both the Alliance and the Horde.

sections.title: Lands to Explore
sections.body:
Zephras Isle floats in Skywall as the Skyborne's homeland. East of the Burning Steppes, the Riverglades is an old Stormwind frontier lost in the First War. Loyalists at Farholde Keep hold out against the wilds, Horde outposts and the Twilight's Hammer at Sunnyglade.

Shen'dralas is a rugged borderland between Desolace, Feralas and Mulgore, contested by centaur, quilboar and outcasts. Mount Hyjal, sacred to the night elves, still bears the scars of Archimonde's defeat. In the Alterac Mountains, the Kirin Tor have lowered Dalaran's shield and are rebuilding their city. Off Kalimdor's coast, the Horde and the Alliance battle over the Darkspear Islands.

sections.title: Dungeons and Raids
sections.body:
Danger waits beneath cities and in the world's far corners. There is the Hall of Thanes deep under Ironforge and the haunted Ruins of Lordaeron above the Undercity. An excavation site lies in the Wetlands, alongside the City of Dalaran itself.

Farther afield are the Drowned City in Stranglethorn Vale, Krol'dok Stronghold in the Riverglades, Alcaz Prison in Dustwallow Marsh, Blackmaw Hold in Azshara and the Shaper's Terrace in Un'Goro Crater. On Mount Hyjal, the Barrow Deeps and Hyjal Summit test the mightiest war bands.

sections.title: Who Walks Which Path
sections.body:
Warriors come from every race. Paladins are human, dwarf or Forsaken, while shaman are orc, tauren, troll, dwarf or Horde Skyborne. Priests are human, dwarf, gnome, night elf, troll or Forsaken. Mages are human, gnome, orc, troll, Forsaken or Alliance Skyborne.

Warlocks are human, gnome, orc, troll or Forsaken. Hunters are human, dwarf, night elf, orc, tauren, troll or Skyborne. Rogues come from every race but the tauren. Druids are night elf, tauren or Skyborne.

faq.q: When is World of Warcraft: Forever set?
faq.answer: World of Warcraft: Forever is set in the year after the Third War, once the Forsaken have claimed the Undercity. Thrall leads the Horde from Orgrimmar. Highlord Bolvar Fordragon is regent of Stormwind for the boy-king Anduin, and the Scourge still holds the Plaguelands.

faq.q: What lands can I explore in WoW Forever?
faq.answer: You can explore Zephras Isle, the Skyborne's floating home in Skywall, and the old Stormwind frontier of the Riverglades. Shen'dralas lies between Desolace, Feralas and Mulgore, while Mount Hyjal is sacred to the night elves. Dalaran is rising again in the Alterac Mountains, and the Horde and Alliance fight over the Darkspear Islands.

The Skyborne are high elves descended from night elves who fled Eldre'Thalas ages ago and lived on Zephras Isle in Skywall, the Elemental Plane of Air. With their island crumbling, they look back toward Azeroth and fight for both the Alliance and the Horde.

Dalaran stands on the shore of Lordamere Lake in the Alterac Mountains. Archimonde shattered the city in the Third War. The Kirin Tor raised a shield over its ruins, and have now lowered it as they rebuild the city.

faq.q: What dungeons and raids are there?
faq.answer: Among the dungeons are the Hall of Thanes under Ironforge, the Ruins of Lordaeron above the Undercity, an excavation site in the Wetlands and the City of Dalaran. Others include the Drowned City in Stranglethorn Vale, Krol'dok Stronghold in the Riverglades, Alcaz Prison in Dustwallow Marsh, Blackmaw Hold in Azshara and the Shaper's Terrace in Un'Goro Crater. The raids are the Barrow Deeps and Hyjal Summit on Mount Hyjal, and Onyxia's Lair in Dustwallow Marsh.

faq.q: Which classes can each race be?
faq.answer:
Humans can be warriors, paladins, hunters, rogues, priests, mages or warlocks. Dwarves can be warriors, paladins, hunters, rogues, priests or shaman. Night elves can be warriors, hunters, rogues, priests or druids. Gnomes can be warriors, rogues, priests, mages or warlocks.

Orcs can be warriors, hunters, rogues, shaman, mages or warlocks. Forsaken can be warriors, paladins, rogues, priests, mages or warlocks. Tauren can be warriors, hunters, shaman or druids. Trolls can be warriors, hunters, rogues, priests, shaman, mages or warlocks.

Skyborne can be warriors, hunters, rogues or druids. Alliance Skyborne can also be mages, and Horde Skyborne can also be shaman.

angles.text: Your people have only begun to return to Azeroth. Both the Alliance and the Horde have taken Skyborne into their ranks.
Some Forsaken still wield the Holy Light as paladins, though it burns them. Tyr's Watch holds Bandarion Keep in western Tirisfal.
Dwarves of Ironforge walk the shaman's path as well as the Light's. They call on stone and storm.
